ruleDefinitions.name: File Download with Headless Browser
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of chromium based browser in headless mode using the "dump-dom" command line to download files

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vivaldi\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-headless.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*dump\\-dom.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http.*")))
